name: novel-finalization
description: Gate proof, final branch state, manuscript completeness, provenance, and export readiness.
procedure: Read the current plan and manuscript to identify unfinished work.
Review continuity, unresolved promises, prose, and publication requirements.
Apply requested corrections through writing tools and record completion or remaining issues in project docs.
Choose the next step from the author's goal and current project state; keep progress in project docs and verify persisted tool results.
